_note: Hypothetical land to test with MODE=west node climate.mjs ../atlas/data. Polygons in world px. 'west' = a continent in the western ocean (x -570..-390, y 170..485, about 1500 x 2700 mi) so the ocean west of Sellador has a western shore: wind-driven water piles up against it and runs north along its east coast (a Gulf Stream), then east to Sellador (a North Atlantic Drift).

wall._note: A high coastal range on the east edge of Curmeah (world x 690-712, y 428-520, just inland of El-Alahd), to strip the north-east trade winds. The first try, an island chain 150-250 mi offshore, did nothing: the warm sea re-moistens the air within a few hundred miles.
